svg.title: Rotary table – exploded view and assembly order
svg.text: Rotary table B-axis – exploded view with part numbers and assembly order
base face = datum A (on stand J1)
Turn the housing 180° on J1 – the parts below go in FROM BELOW
Order: 1 → 2 → 3 → turn 180° → 4 → 5 → contact pattern → 11 spacer → 6 → 7 → 8 → 9 → 10 → grind top → run-in → ISO 230-2
Worm cartridge (5) can be pre-assembled on the bench in parallel (task 7a, chapter 17.3).
